title: Microstructure and mechanical properties of a refractory AlMo0.5NbTa0.5TiZr high-entropy alloy manufactured by laser-directed energy deposition
process_description: prepared by laser-directed energy deposition (L-DED) using element powder blends with laser power of 5 kW, laser scanning speed of 800 mm/min, and laser powder feeding rate of 35–45 g/min, followed by annealing at 600 °C for two hours with furnace cooling.
